evals.name: core-context-gate
evals.prompt: Add a GET /orders/health endpoint that returns {"status": "ok"}.
evals.expected_output: The agent reads .clean/context.json and the packs it lists before its first edit, then adds the endpoint to the existing orders router.
expectations: Reads the Express pack that context.json lists
The endpoint lives in the existing orders router
Nothing new at the repository root

evals.name: core-init
evals.prompt: /clean-code init. Answer the interview yourself: the purpose is an order API for a bakery; the actors are bakery staff and customers; do not enforce layers; the verify command is npm test; there are no no-go zones.
evals.expected_output: .clean/context.json holds the detected stack with its packs and the confirmed answers; .clean/structure.md maps the project; no code changes.

evals.name: core-layers-declared
evals.prompt: Orders over 500 EUR need a manager's approval before they are placed. Add that rule.
evals.expected_output: The approval rule lands in the domain or application layer; the domain never imports Express; the declared layering still passes.
expectations: The threshold is not decided in the HTTP adapter
The domain knows the approval rule

evals.name: core-no-sibling
evals.prompt: Improve the error handling in src/services/payment.js.
evals.expected_output: payment.js itself is improved: the swallowed error is handled or rethrown with its cause; no copy of the file appears.
